{"id":2025356332,"question_id":695,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 2 weeks","timestamp":1780836084,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2025356332/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Max Area of Island","memory":"31.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int n , m;\n\n    int BFS(vector<vector<int>>& grid)\n    {\n        vector<vector<bool>> vis(m, vector<bool>(n, false));\n\n        int ans = 0;\n\n        vector<int> dr = {-1, 1, 0, 0};\n        vector<int> dc = {0, 0, -1, 1};\n\n        for(int i = 0; i < m; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0; j < n; j++)\n            {\n                if(grid[i][j] == 1 && !vis[i][j])\n                {\n                    queue<pair<int, int>> q;\n                    q.push({i, j});\n                    vis[i][j] = true;\n\n                    int area = 0;\n\n                    while(!q.empty())\n                    {\n                        auto [r, c] = q.front();\n                        q.pop();\n\n                        area++;\n\n                        for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)\n                        {\n                            int nr = r + dr[k];\n                            int nc = c + dc[k];\n\n                            if(nr >= 0 && nr < m and nc >= 0 and nc < n and grid[nr][nc] == 1 and !vis[nr][nc])\n                            {\n                                vis[nr][nc] = true;\n                                q.push({nr, nc});\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    ans = max(ans, area);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n\n    int maxAreaOfIsland(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        m = grid.size();\n        n = grid[0].size();\n\n        return BFS(grid);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"max-area-of-island","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2065}
